entry.digest: Create alpha channel from second input
entry.description: Creates an alpha channel on input using luminance or specified plane from the second input.

attributes.digest: Alpha fade amount
attributes.description: The alpha channel fade amount. A value of 0. results in alpha values equivalent to the left input values, while a value of 1.0 (the default) results in alpha values equivalent to the right input.
